# pve_ceph_status (Data Source)

Ceph cluster status as observed from one node: the raw `ceph status` payload from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/status`, derived health and quorum summaries, the monitor roster, and the cluster-wide metadata from `GET /cluster/ceph/metadata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_status" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "ceph_health" {
  value = data.pve_ceph_status.pve1.health
}

output "ceph_quorum" {
  value = data.pve_ceph_status.pve1.quorum_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node through which the Ceph status is queried.

### Read-Only

- `health` (String) Aggregate Ceph health summary derived from the raw status payload: `HEALTH_OK`, `HEALTH_WARN`, or `HEALTH_ERR`.
- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the queried node name.
- `metadata_json` (String) Raw cluster metadata JSON exactly as returned by `GET /cluster/ceph/metadata`; the pin types this payload as an unstructured object.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Ceph monitors known to the queried node (from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/mon`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `quorum_names` (List of String) Names of the monitors currently forming the Ceph quorum.
- `status_json` (String) Raw `ceph status` JSON exactly as returned by `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/status`; the pin types this payload as an unstructured object.
- `versions` (Map of Number) Map of Ceph daemon version string to the number of daemons reporting that version.

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `addr` (String) Ceph-formatted monitor address (typically `IP:PORT/NONCE`).
- `ceph_version` (String) Full Ceph version string of the monitor daemon.
- `host` (String) Host the monitor runs on.
- `in_quorum` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is part of the current quorum.
- `name` (String) Monitor ID (typically the hostname).
- `rank` (Number) Rank of the monitor within the mon map.
- `service` (Boolean) Whether a `ceph-mon@<id>` systemd unit is enabled on the hosting node.
- `state` (String) Run state of the monitor: `running`, `stopped`, or `unknown`.
